name: Facet
text: Choose a dark theme by default with a manual light-mode toggle. High contrast improves visibility in low light, and our competitive analysis shows dark themes perform better for interactive data visualization. The trade-off is that some users may prefer light themes, but we mitigate this with a persistent override that remembers their choice. This balances accessibility with the goal of clarity and enjoyment.

name: Pane
text: The real risk isn’t preference—it’s habituation. Users won’t switch from dark mode once set, even if light mode better suits their task. A better alternative: default to system preference, with a manual toggle for either theme. Settle it with A/B testing—measure task completion speed and error rates in both modes.
